title: Fall i Asien och havererade tullförhandlingar
summary_md:
# Fall i Asien och havererade tullförhandlingar

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon opens the week with pressure from high long-term rates and a tech sell-off in Asia. Samsung, SK Hynix and Alibaba all fell, Alibaba after announcing a huge discounted share issue to fund AI. The hosts cover the US financial offensive against Iran, the collapse of US–Canada tariff talks, the rally in bitcoin and gold, and what is coming up: Nvidia's earnings, US PCE inflation and Warsh's Jackson Hole speech. The mood is cautious and risk-off; the only clearly positive stock call is SEB's buy recommendation on Sandvik.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SAND — Sandvik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

SEB buy recommendation: underlying demand growth expected to broaden.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view (SEB), not the hosts' own. SEB expects Sandvik's underlying demand growth to broaden, which supports a positive re-rating. The hosts expect it to set the tone on the Stockholm exchange today.

#### Sell Triggers

- if underlying demand growth fails to broaden
- if the macro/tariff environment hurts industrial orders

> *"Sandvik, som har fått en köprekommendation från SEB där man ser att en underliggande efterfrågetillväxt för Sandvik kommer att breddas"*

---

### ⛔ BABA — Alibaba | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Discounted ~100bn placement to fund AI while profits fall; Michael Burry has sold and is negative.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited investor view (Michael Burry), repeated by the hosts. The heavy dilution at an 8% discount, AI spending that is not expected to lift earnings, and falling profits leave investors worried about getting their money back.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI investment starts showing clear profit growth
- if profit decline reverses

> *"Det är ännu en orsak till att vara negativ till Baba."*

---

### 🟠 SSAB-B — SSAB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Sold off on US 50% tariffs on Canada; many expect a rebound if the tariffs are reversed.

#### Reasoning

The hosts cite market consensus that SSAB would rise if the US tariffs on Canadian goods are reversed. Talks have broken down, so the catalyst is uncertain and depends on politics, with the US midterm elections as a factor.

#### Sell Triggers

- if tariffs remain or escalate
- if Canada–US talks stay broken down

> *"Om det här reverseras är det många som tror att SSAB kommer att stiga."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Wednesday's report is the week's key event amid a weak AI trade; guidance matters more than sales.

#### Reasoning

The hosts see the report as pivotal for AI sentiment. Nobody expects weak sales, but the stock tends to fall even on strong reports because the market wants more. Its price increases may feed inflation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if forward guidance disappoints
- if the AI trade keeps weakening

> *"Nvidia kommer med rapport på onsdag kväll. Det blir veckans riktiga bomb."*

---

### 🟠 SIVE — Sivers | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Thursday report after close; the stock is down a lot with heavy selling; focus is on how the opportunity pipeline is valued.

#### Reasoning

The hosts find the report exciting because of the opportunity pipeline presentation. The stock has fallen sharply on heavy selling, and the late report timing is read sceptically ('the later the report, the worse the company').

#### Sell Triggers

- if the opportunity pipeline value disappoints
- if selling pressure continues

> *"Sivers blir ju alltid spännande såklart."*

---
